title: EAS broadcast
description: An Emergency Alert System message as the public and broadcasters see it. Variant tv_crawl is a 1280x720 TV frame with the crawl text the station equipment generates; variant decoder_log is the printout of an EAS decoder with the raw SAME header. The header and the crawl sentence are built by the app from these fields. Station ids are simulated.

originator.description: SAME originator: CIV civil authorities, WXR National Weather Service, EAS EAS participant, PEP Primary Entry Point

areaNames.description: Names of the areas for the crawl, in the same order, up to 31

issued.description: When the message was issued. Date and time with a UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-21T14:14:00-04:00 (never Z)

purgeMinutes.description: How long the message is valid, in minutes (15 to 360; rounded up to a valid EAS step)

station.description: Station or sender id, 8 characters; use EXERCISE or a fictional call sign, never a real station

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the crawl times

source.description: Agency that asked for the message

details.description: Optional extra line shown under the crawl, e.g. what to do
examples: Move to higher ground and avoid flooded roads.
